summary: The identities SecurityInsight runs as move safely to standard, consistent names.

fixes.title: Identities move to their standard names
fixes.text: Once switched on, older installations move to the standard identity names one role at a time. Each new identity gets every right and is proven before the old one is removed.

fixes.title: Updates report each identity's name
fixes.text: Every update now tells you, per role, whether the identity carries its standard name.

fixes.title: Database administrators group gets its standard name
fixes.text: The database administrators group is renamed in place, with the same members. New installations create it under that name.
